answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed if duplicate behavior is proven, so a harbor of honest agents keeps working while an attacker must fund every fake identity separately. Without a shared shortcut, creating thousands of copies triggers a cost spiral: each clone needs its own stake, compute, and history, while a light zephyr of free identities cannot pass because reputation only accrues after verifiable work over time. Sybil scale therefore becomes linear in money, not free.
